model_name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B (ternary GGUF by Prism ML, Qwen3.8-27B base)

server.note: stock llama.cpp rejects PTQ1_0/PQ2_0 as unknown types; PrismML fork required

host.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU, 6141 MiB VRAM

PQ2_0.result: OOM at load (failed to create context)

cpu_only_measurements.verdict: CPU-only is 3.4x slower decode and 4x slower prompt processing than the tuned 47-layer GPU offload (0.88/4.17 tok-s); PTQ1_0 on CPU is the worst option at 0.11 tok-s due to scalar-only ternary vec_dot

cpu_kernel_patch.what: restructured PQ2_0 x q8_0 vec_dot: element-order 2-bit code spread, dpbusd u8x s8 dot minus sum(qy) on VNNI, maddubs path on plain AVX2 (new), single fp32 accumulator + one hsum per block (was 8 hsum_i32_8 per block); scalar fallback kept
cpu_kernel_patch.unit_test: /tmp/pq2_avx2_test.c: 512/512 randomized trials match generic incl. all-code-3 stress
cpu_kernel_patch.standalone_bench: 7168x5120 GEMV layer: 9.8 ms vs 44.1 ms scalar generic = 4.48x (single thread)
cpu_kernel_patch.bottleneck_after_kernel: thread-count-independent serial floor ~600 ms/token (t4 1.03 / t6 1.10 / t8 1.27 / t12 1.19 tok/s): unfused Gated Delta Net recurrence + per-layer small-op graph scheduling, not matmul; fused GDN is auto-disabled by the device-mismatch probe (llama-context.cpp resolve_fused_ops, no CLI override)
cpu_kernel_patch.ceiling: ngl 48 aborts at load (core dump), 47 confirmed max VRAM fit

fused_gdn_experiment.what: env-gated GGML_FORCE_FGDN in llama-context.cpp resolve_fused_ops: keeps fused_gdn_ar/ch enabled despite the layer-vs-fused-node device mismatch (only CUDA implements the fused op; sched copies state/inputs across PCIe for CPU-resident layers)
fused_gdn_experiment.amdahl: serial floor shrank only ~605 -> ~530 ms/token; remaining serial cost is the CPU<->GPU per-layer pipeline (small-op scheduling and sync for the 47/65 split), not GDN or matmul
fused_gdn_experiment.verdict: fused GDN kept as the new best config; 27B decode on this 6 GB laptop is architecturally capped near ~1.4 tok/s without scheduler-level work

screen_recording.what: 8.4 min screen recording (1280x720@10fps h264) of Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B (PQ2_0, 47/65 layers, GGML_FORCE_FGDN) running in the llama-server WebUI opened inside the ZCode in-app browser: typed analysis request, prompt processing stats (154 tok @ 9 tok/s), live reasoning + final 8-line filesystem analysis of /home/sweker/work (43 projects, 96G), 715 tokens at 1.20 tok/s
screen_recording.capture: ZCode in-app browser tab recording API (webm segments stitched via ffmpeg concat)
screen_recording.redaction: one company directory renamed to 'acme-corp' in the shown data at the user's request (name not public); an earlier terminal-recording take that showed it was deleted
screen_recording.note: WebUI Custom JSON setting: {"chat_template_kwargs": {"reasoning_effort": "medium"}} keeps the thinking budget bounded (715 tokens total vs 1400+ unbounded)

ptq1_0_head_cpu_recipe.source: https://x.com/cheese_cakee_9/status/2103884349162823919 (RTX 4050 laptop, same GPU class: 11.8 tok/s recorded, 15.3 unrecorded)
ptq1_0_head_cpu_recipe.patch: patches/prism-fork-avx2-kernels.patch (combined fork diff: PQ2_0 AVX2 kernel, PTQ1_0 AVX2 kernel, FGDN force experiment)
ptq1_0_head_cpu_recipe.what: PTQ1_0 (5.9 GB) with ALL 65 transformer layers on GPU (-ngl 99) and only the output head offloaded to CPU (-ot output.weight=CPU, frees ~265 MiB so PTQ1_0 fits); fused Gated Delta Net auto-enables (no device mismatch); new AVX2/VNNI ggml_vec_dot_ptq1_0_q8_0 SIMD kernel for the CPU-side head (fork's PTQ1_0 CPU path was scalar-only)
ptq1_0_head_cpu_recipe.kernel_unit_test: 512/512 randomized trials match the scalar generic (bytes constrained to valid 5-trit encodings <= 242); standalone layer GEMV 4.24x vs generic
ptq1_0_head_cpu_recipe.launch: scripts/run.sh ternary-bonsai-2-27b --skip-preflight (EXTRA_SERVER_ARGS=-ot output.weight=CPU; requires run.sh extra-args passthrough added this session)
ptq1_0_head_cpu_recipe.gap_vs_tweet: RESOLVED: gap was power-saver platform profile (CPU pinned at 1.0 GHz of 4.6 GHz). powerprofilesctl set performance -> 12.7-13.2 tok/s decode, 65.7 tok/s pp; see power_profile_fix

power_profile_fix.root_cause: laptop in power-saver platform profile (EPP=power): ALL CPU cores pinned at 1.0 GHz of 4.6 GHz max during decode; GPU 80% idle waiting on CPU; all pre-fix measurements on this host were at ~1/4 clock
power_profile_fix.vs_tweet: X post showed 11.8 recorded / 15.3 unrecorded on the same GPU class -> now matched and slightly exceeded

winner.layers: all 65 transformer layers on GPU; only output head (~265 MiB) on CPU
winner.launch: scripts/run.sh ternary-bonsai-2-27b --skip-preflight; requires performance power profile

notes: PTQ1_0 cannot fully fit 6141 MiB VRAM: weights ~5.67 GiB alone equal free VRAM at launch (5666 MiB); auto-fit projected 6396 MiB used vs 5066 free at 8k ctx and reduced ngl to 39. Needs ~7 GB VRAM for full offload.
PTQ1_0 CPU matmul is generic scalar in this fork (arch-fallback.h: no SIMD vec_dot yet), ~0.14 s/layer vs PQ2_0 SIMD ~0.053 s/layer; this is why PTQ1_0 decode lags PQ2_0 despite its smaller file.
GPU util ~0% during decode is expected: GPU kernels are tiny under multi-second CPU steps; offload verified by linear speedup as ngl increases.
Fused Gated Delta Net (autoregressive/chunked) kernels reported unsupported on this build; unfused path used.
No speculative-decoding drafter ships for Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B (checked prism-ml repos); dspark drafter documented only for the older Bonsai-27B and needs a gguf-dspark-to-dflash conversion.
Chat template: Qwen3-style thinking model; sampling per model card: temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, top-k 20.
